title: Migrate legacy accounts and validate the first public paid release
description:
Implement phase H of docs/architecture/hosted-platform-plan.md. Read the complete architecture and user constraints before work. Keep mutable state in Beads. No infrastructure purchase, commit, push, or production deployment is authorized by this issue.

## Acceptance Criteria
Complete phase H and section 11. Rehearse expand/backfill/contract and rollback without losing accepted usage or billing records. Resolve users owning multiple organizations without duplicate invoices. Run one simulated billing cycle, at least 14 days of internal live shadow measurement, isolation review, capacity/abuse tests, database and control-plane restore drills, and all relevant Linux CI/build/coverage checks. Record evidence and release decision. Public self-service is the first customer release; do not require an invited-only release.

title: Deliver managed PostgreSQL with pooling, secrets, and tested recovery
description:
Implement phase E of docs/architecture/hosted-platform-plan.md. Read the complete architecture and user constraints before work. Keep mutable state in Beads. No infrastructure purchase, commit, push, or production deployment is authorized by this issue.

## Acceptance Criteria
Complete phase E using only the phase A selected backend. Provide scoped pooled/direct TLS connections, non-superuser customer roles, encrypted credentials, resource and connection limits, safe resize/rotation, exports, and external database support. Prove tenant isolation and restore to a new instance after host loss. Pass proposed 7-day history, 5-minute RPO, and 60-minute RTO for up to 20 GiB or revise the service contract before release. Test disk exhaustion, backup failure, interrupted operations, and relevant full coverage/build gates.

title: Set hosted service, licensing, pricing, and database cost contracts
description:
Implement phase A of docs/architecture/hosted-platform-plan.md. Read the complete architecture and user constraints before work. Keep mutable state in Beads. No infrastructure purchase, commit, push, or production deployment is authorized by this issue.

## Acceptance Criteria
Record supported workloads, production region and currency, fixed price-unit semantics, licensing composition, billing-provider selection, trial and retention rules. Compare operated Azure PostgreSQL and managed-provider total direct costs at 10, 100, and 1000 databases for all four plan scenarios at equal performance and recovery. Show labor separately. Select a provider only if its cost is equal or lower for the approved envelope; otherwise retain operated PostgreSQL. Publish a durable ADR and proposed price sheet before procurement.

title: Deliver public multi-tenant hosting with usage billing and managed PostgreSQL
description:
Implement the first paid public self-service release defined in docs/architecture/hosted-platform-plan.md, phases A-H. Reuse existing organizations and deployment services. Default to operated PostgreSQL; an embedded provider is permitted only when its direct cost is no greater than our own infrastructure at comparable service requirements. Preserve external database connections.

## Success Criteria
Public signup, tenant and runtime isolation, managed PostgreSQL recovery, reliable usage, organization invoices, quotas, spending controls, migration, and release evidence satisfy the plan. Every child acceptance gate passes before launch. No readiness claim is based on planning alone.

title: Plan CDN, edge execution, and database preview extensions
description:
Define and evaluate phase I of docs/architecture/hosted-platform-plan.md after the first public release. Compare Vercel CDN, regional functions, and edge execution; compare Neon branching, autoscaling, and suspend/resume. Keep external database compatibility and the provider cost rule.

## Acceptance Criteria
Produce separate costed designs for CDN, additional regions, a sandboxed function runtime, and expiring full-copy database previews. Distinguish CDN from edge execution and full copies from copy-on-write branches. Include meter contracts, isolation tests, and acceptance before implementation. Do not build a new storage engine or global network under this task.
